units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 10) where a contract is concluded with a sole supplier (contractor, service provider) under Article 93(1), points 1, 3, 6, 8, 21, 22, 23, 29, 32, 34, 40, 41, 46, 51, 52, 56, 59 and 62, of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 11) where, during performance of a contract under Article 34, paragraph 16 (provided that the life-cycle contract includes design, construction, reconstruction or major repairs of a capital construction facility) or paragraph 16.1, of this Federal Law, the estimated construction, reconstruction or major repair cost, determined following verification of its reliability during State expert examination of design documentation, exceeds the contract price. Material terms may be amended under this point taking account of that estimated cost for the capital construction facility, by decision of the Government of the Russian Federation, the highest executive authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the local administration, for federal, constituent-entity or municipal procurement respectively, provided the amendment does not increase the contract price by more than thirty percent;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 12) where, during contract performance, the period for a separate stage or stages of performance is changed within the overall performance period specified when the contract was concluded;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 13) where, during performance of a contract concluded for at least one year for scientific research, experimental design or technological work, whose price equals or exceeds the threshold or thresholds set by the Government of the Russian Federation, circumstances beyond the parties' control arise that make performance impossible. An amendment under this point requires a written justification and a decision of the Government of the Russian Federation, the highest executive authority of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the local administration, for federal, constituent-entity or municipal procurement respectively, and may not increase the performance period and/or contract price by more than thirty percent;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 14) where the performance period of a construction supervision contract needs to be changed as a consequence of, and within the extent of, an increase or reduction in the performance period of the contract for construction, reconstruction or major repairs of the capital construction facility during which that supervision is undertaken, without changing any other material terms of the construction supervision contract.
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.1. Repealed from 1 January 2017. — Federal Law of 29.12.2015 No. 390-FZ.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.2. If, during performance of a contract under Article 34, paragraph 16 (provided that the life-cycle contract includes design, construction, reconstruction or major repairs of a capital construction facility) or paragraph 16.1, of this Federal Law, the contract price exceeds the estimated construction, reconstruction or major repair cost of the capital construction facility determined following verification of its reliability during State expert examination of design documentation, the contract price shall be reduced taking account of that estimated cost.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.3. Amendments under paragraph 1 of this Article are conditional on the supplier (contractor, service provider) providing performance security in accordance with this Federal Law, if the amendments create new obligations not covered by the security previously provided and if performance security was required under Article 96 of this Federal Law during supplier (contractor, service provider) selection. In that case:
units.label: Part 1.3 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1) the amount of security may be reduced in the manner and cases specified in Article 96(7)–(7.3) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1.3 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 2) performance security may be provided by appropriately amending the terms of the independent guarantee previously provided to the contracting authority;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1.3 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 3) if performance security is provided by a new independent guarantee, the contracting authority shall not return the previous guarantee to its issuing guarantor, no claim shall be enforced under it, the contracting authority shall be deemed to have waived its rights under it, and the guarantor's obligation to the contracting authority under it shall cease when the new independent guarantee is issued;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1.3 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 4) if the contract price is increased under this Article and performance security is provided in cash, the supplier (contractor, service provider) shall deposit an amount proportional to the value of its new obligations in the account used under Russian Federation legislation to record transactions involving funds received by the contracting authority.
units.label: Point 4 Part 1.3 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.4. If the contract price is reduced under this Article, the contracting authority shall return to the supplier (contractor, service provider) the cash deposited as performance security in proportion to that price reduction.
units.label: Part 1.4 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.5. If the performance period is changed, the parties shall agree, under Article 34(27) of this Federal Law, a new period for the contracting authority to return to the supplier (contractor, service provider) the cash deposited as performance security.
units.label: Part 1.5 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.6. A State or municipal contracting authority, as a recipient of budget funds, may make amendments under paragraph 1 of this Article within the budget commitment limits communicated under Russian Federation budget legislation for the contract performance period.
units.label: Part 1.6 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1.7. An agreement amending a contract concluded following electronic procedures or closed electronic procedures shall be concluded using the unified information system. In the cases specified in Article 103(5) of this Federal Law, the agreement shall not be posted on the official website.
units.label: Part 1.7 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 2. In the cases specified in paragraph 1(6) of this Article, the quantity of goods or volume of work or services shall be reduced when the contract price is reduced in accordance with the methodology approved by the Government of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 3. In the cases specified in paragraph 1(6) of this Article, the State or municipal contracting authority shall decide on a contract amendment resulting from reduced budget commitment limits on the basis of proportional changes to the contract price and the quantity of goods or volume of work or services.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 4. Where the circumstances specified in paragraph 1(6) of this Article make it impossible for a State or municipal contracting authority to fulfil budget commitments arising from a contract, it shall give priority to obligations under a contract for goods necessary for citizens' normal subsistence and/or a contract under which the supplier (contractor, service provider) has performed its obligations.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 5. The supplier (contractor, service provider) may not be replaced during contract performance unless the new supplier (contractor, service provider) is its legal successor under that contract as a result of a legal entity's reorganisation by transformation, merger or accession.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 6. If the contracting authority is replaced, its rights and obligations under the contract shall pass to the new contracting authority.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 7. Repealed from 1 October 2026. — Federal Law of 04.08.2026 No. 279-FZ.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 8. A contract may be terminated by agreement of the parties, by a court decision, or through a party's unilateral refusal to perform in accordance with civil legislation.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 8.1. An agreement terminating a contract concluded following electronic procedures or closed electronic procedures shall be concluded using the unified information system. In the cases specified in Article 103(5) of this Federal Law, the agreement shall not be posted on the official website.
units.label: Part 8.1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 9. The contracting authority may decide to refuse performance unilaterally on grounds laid down in the Civil Code of the Russian Federation for unilateral refusal to perform particular types of obligations, provided the contract allows this.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 10. Before deciding to refuse performance unilaterally under paragraph 8 of this Article, the contracting authority may engage experts or expert organisations to examine the goods delivered, work performed or services rendered.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 11. If the contracting authority has engaged experts or expert organisations to examine the goods delivered, work performed or services rendered, it may decide to refuse performance unilaterally only if the expert's or expert organisation's opinion confirms the contractual breaches forming the grounds for that refusal.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 12. Repealed from 1 January 2022. — Federal Law of 02.07.2021 No. 360-FZ.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 12.1. Where the contracting authority decides under paragraph 9 of this Article to refuse unilaterally to perform a contract concluded following electronic procedures or closed electronic procedures:
units.label: Part 12.1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1) the contracting authority shall use the unified information system to prepare the decision, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorised to act on its behalf, and post it in that system. In the cases specified in Article 103(5) of this Federal Law, the decision shall not be posted on the official website;
units.label: Point 1 Part 12.1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 2) no later than one hour after being posted in the unified information system under point 1 of this paragraph, the decision shall automatically be sent through that system to the supplier (contractor, service provider). The date of receipt by the supplier (contractor, service provider) shall be the date on which the decision is posted in the system under this point, according to the time zone in which the supplier (contractor, service provider) is located;
units.label: Point 2 Part 12.1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 3) receipt of the decision under point 2 of this paragraph shall constitute proper notification of the supplier (contractor, service provider) of the unilateral refusal to perform the contract.
units.label: Point 3 Part 12.1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 12.2. Where the contracting authority decides under paragraph 9 of this Article to refuse unilaterally to perform a contract concluded following a closed tender or closed auction, or in procurement under Article 93 (except procurement under Article 93(12) of this Federal Law), Article 111 (where special arrangements established under Article 111(1) of this Federal Law provide that information and documents are not posted in the unified information system or on the official website during supplier (contractor, service provider) selection) or Article 111.1 of this Federal Law, the decision shall be delivered personally against acknowledgement to a person authorised to act on behalf of the supplier (contractor, service provider), or sent to the supplier (contractor, service provider) at its contractual address in compliance with Russian Federation legislation on State secrets. Compliance with this paragraph by the contracting authority constitutes proper notification of the supplier (contractor, service provider) of the unilateral refusal. The date of proper notification shall be:
units.label: Part 12.2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1) the date stated by the person authorised to act on behalf of the supplier (contractor, service provider) in the acknowledgement of receipt of the decision (if delivered personally against acknowledgement to such an authorised person);
units.label: Point 1 Part 12.2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 2) the date on which the contracting authority receives confirmation of delivery to the supplier (contractor, service provider) of the registered letter provided for in this paragraph, or receives information that the supplier (contractor, service provider) is absent from the contractual address or that the letter has been returned after expiry of its retention period (if the decision is sent by registered letter).
units.label: Point 2 Part 12.2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 13. The contracting authority's decision to refuse performance unilaterally shall enter into force, and the contract shall be deemed terminated, ten days after the date on which the contracting authority properly notified the supplier (contractor, service provider) of that refusal.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 14. The contracting authority shall cancel a decision to refuse performance unilaterally that has not yet entered into force if, within ten days of proper notification of the supplier (contractor, service provider), the contractual breach giving rise to the decision has been remedied and the contracting authority has been reimbursed for the expert examination under paragraph 10 of this Article. This rule does not apply to repeated breaches by the supplier (contractor, service provider) of contract terms that constitute grounds under civil legislation for the contracting authority's unilateral refusal to perform.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 14.1. If the contracting authority cancels, under this Federal Law, a decision to refuse performance unilaterally that has not yet entered into force and was posted in the unified information system under paragraph 12.1 of this Article, no later than the day following cancellation it shall use that system to prepare a notice of cancellation, sign it with the enhanced electronic signature of a person authorised to act on its behalf, and post it in that system. In the cases specified in Article 103(5) of this Federal Law, the notice shall not be posted on the official website.
units.label: Part 14.1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 14.2. If the contracting authority cancels, under this Federal Law, a decision that has not yet entered into force to refuse unilaterally to perform a contract concluded following a closed tender or closed auction, or in procurement under Article 93 (except procurement under Article 93(12) of this Federal Law), Article 111 (where special arrangements established under Article 111(1) of this Federal Law provide that information and documents are not posted in the unified information system or on the official website during supplier (contractor, service provider) selection) or Article 111.1 of this Federal Law, no later than three working days following cancellation it shall deliver a notice of cancellation personally against acknowledgement to a person authorised to act on behalf of the supplier (contractor, service provider), or send it to the supplier (contractor, service provider) at its contractual address in compliance with Russian Federation legislation on State secrets.
units.label: Part 14.2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 15. The contracting authority shall decide to refuse performance unilaterally in the following cases:
units.label: Part 15 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1) if it is established during contract performance that:
units.label: Point 1 Part 15 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: а) the supplier (contractor, service provider) and/or the goods supplied no longer meet the requirements for procurement participants and/or goods set by the procurement notice and/or procurement documentation (where this Federal Law requires documentation), except for the requirement under Article 31(1.1) of this Federal Law, if imposed;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 15 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: б) during supplier (contractor, service provider) selection, the supplier (contractor, service provider) submitted false information on its compliance and/or the supplied goods' compliance with the requirements in subpoint а of this point, enabling it to win that selection;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 15 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: в) if, following reorganisation of the legal entity acting as contractor (service provider), its rights and obligations under the contract have passed to a newly formed legal entity registered in a foreign State, and either a prohibition or restriction on procurement of work or services respectively performed or provided by foreign persons in respect of that State has been imposed under Article 14(2)(1), subpoints а and б, of this Federal Law and the contractor (service provider) was a Russian person, or a preference for work or services respectively performed or provided by Russian persons has been established under Article 14(2)(1)(в) of this Federal Law and the contractor (service provider) was a Russian person;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 1 Part 15 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 2) if, during performance of a contract concluded under Article 93(1)(47) of this Federal Law for goods whose production has been established, modernised and/or mastered in the Russian Federation under a special investment contract, that special investment contract is terminated. The contract concluded under Article 93(1)(47) of this Federal Law shall then be terminated as follows:
units.label: Point 2 Part 15 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: а) within ten working days of termination, the party that concluded the special investment contract on behalf of the Russian Federation (or the Russian Federation together with a constituent entity and/or municipality) shall notify the contracting authorities that concluded supply contracts under Article 93(1)(47) of this Federal Law whose obligations remain unperformed on the date of notification. Notices of termination of the special investment contract shall be sent by registered post with acknowledgement of receipt to the contracting authorities' contractual addresses. The relevant contracting authorities shall be identified from the register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 15 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: б) no later than three working days after receipt of the notice in subpoint а of this point, the contracting authorities shall decide to refuse unilaterally to perform the contract concluded under Article 93(1)(47) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 15 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: в) after the decision in subpoint б of this point, the contract shall be terminated in accordance with the general procedure established in this Article;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 15 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 3) if, during performance of a contract concluded under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law, a contract with reciprocal investment obligations concluded under Article 111.4 of this Federal Law is terminated. The contract concluded under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law shall then be terminated as follows:
units.label: Point 3 Part 15 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: а) within ten working days of termination, the party that concluded the contract with reciprocal investment obligations on behalf of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation under Article 111.4 of this Federal Law shall notify the contracting authorities that concluded contracts under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law whose obligations remain unperformed on the date of notification. Notices of termination of the contract with reciprocal investment obligations concluded under Article 111.4 of this Federal Law shall be sent by registered post with acknowledgement of receipt to the contracting authorities' contractual addresses. The relevant contracting authorities shall be identified from the register of contracts concluded by contracting authorities;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 3 Part 15 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: б) within three working days after receipt of the notice in subpoint а of this point, the contracting authorities shall decide to refuse unilaterally to perform the contract concluded under Article 93(1)(48) of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 3 Part 15 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: в) after the decision in subpoint б of this point, the contract shall be terminated in accordance with the general procedure established in this Article.
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 3 Part 15 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 16. No later than two working days following the day on which its decision to refuse performance unilaterally due to the supplier's (contractor's, service provider's) non-performance or improper performance of contractual obligations enters into force, the contracting authority shall submit, in the procedure specified in Article 104(10)(1) of this Federal Law, a request to enter information on that supplier (contractor, service provider) in the register of bad-faith suppliers (contractors, service providers).
units.label: Part 16 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 17. If a contract is terminated because the contracting authority unilaterally refuses to perform, it may procure the goods, work or services that were the subject of the terminated contract under Article 24(10)(2)(б) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 17.1. If a contract is terminated on the grounds in paragraph 8 of this Article, the contracting authority may conclude a contract with the procurement participant with whom this Federal Law provides for conclusion of a contract when the winner evades conclusion, subject to that participant's consent. The contract shall comply with Article 34(1) of this Federal Law, taking account of paragraph 18 of this Article, and shall be concluded after the participant provides performance security under this Federal Law if the procurement notice and/or documentation requires it. Where a contract other than one specified in Article 37(9) of this Federal Law is terminated because the contracting authority unilaterally refuses to perform, a contract may be concluded under this paragraph if, in connection with that termination, a decision under Article 104(7) of this Federal Law has been made to enter information on the former supplier (contractor, service provider) in the register of bad-faith suppliers (contractors, service providers), or a decision not to enter that information has been made on grounds established by the Government of the Russian Federation under Article 104(10)(2) of this Federal Law because that decision establishes that force majeure made proper performance by that supplier (contractor, service provider) impossible.
units.label: Part 17.1 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 17.2. In the case specified in paragraph 17.1 of this Article, the contract shall be concluded in the same form and procedure as the terminated contract. In that case:
units.label: Part 17.2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 1) if a contract concluded following an electronic procedure or closed electronic procedure is terminated:
units.label: Point 1 Part 17.2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: а) the contract shall be concluded in the procedure established by Article 51, paragraph 2, points 1 and 2, and paragraphs 3–5, of this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 1 Part 17.2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: б) if the procurement participant posts on the electronic platform a refusal to conclude the contract under Article 51(3)(3) of this Federal Law, or fails within the period specified in Article 51(3) of this Federal Law to fulfil the requirements of Article 51(3)(3) of this Federal Law, the contracting authority may conclude a contract, in the procedure established by Article 51, paragraph 2, points 1 and 2, and paragraphs 3–5, of this Federal Law, with the participant whose application has been assigned the next rank under this Federal Law and who has not withdrawn it under this Federal Law;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 1 Part 17.2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 2) if a contract concluded following a closed tender or closed auction, or in procurement under Article 93 (except procurement under Article 93(12) of this Federal Law), Article 111 (where special arrangements established under Article 111(1) of this Federal Law provide that information and documents are not posted in the unified information system or on the official website during supplier (contractor, service provider) selection) or Article 111.1 of this Federal Law is terminated, the contract shall be concluded in the procedure established by Article 73(14) of this Federal Law.
units.label: Point 2 Part 17.2 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 18. If, before termination, the supplier (contractor, service provider) has partly performed its contractual obligations, the new contract shall reduce the quantity of goods to be supplied or volume of work or services to be performed to take account of those already supplied, performed or rendered under the terminated contract. The price of a contract concluded under paragraphs 17 and 17.1 of this Article shall be reduced proportionally to those quantities or volumes.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 19. The supplier (contractor, service provider) may decide to refuse performance unilaterally on grounds laid down in the Civil Code of the Russian Federation for unilateral refusal to perform particular types of obligations, if the contract provides the contracting authority with the right to decide to refuse performance unilaterally.
units.label: Part 19 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 20. Repealed from 1 January 2022. — Federal Law of 02.07.2021 No. 360-FZ.
units.label: Part 20 Art. 95

units.locator: Article 95. Amendment and termination of a contract
units.text: 20.1. Where the supplier (contractor, service provider) decides under paragraph 19 of this Article to refuse unilaterally to perform a contract concluded following electronic procedures or closed electronic procedures, the decision shall be sent to the contracting authority as follows:
units.label: Part 20.1 Art. 95
